statement: The pinned WiiBrew Output Report common information section describes bit 2 (0x04) of the first payload byte as an enable/disable state for report modes and peripherals: reports 0x12, 0x13, 0x14, 0x19 and 0x1A use this shared interpretation for their respective features. The Reading and Writing section uses that same bit on reports 0x16/0x17 to select control-register access instead of EEPROM, and also documents bit 3 as an alternative register selector that must not be combined with bit 2. Separately, setting bit 1 (0x02) on an output requests input acknowledgement report 0x22. These are field-specific overlapping conventions; bit 2 is not a universal enable flag.
